name: Roadgrip Tyres & Wheels
description: A bold rubber-black and sidewall-red theme for tyre and wheel shops: a giant sidewall hero with raised lettering, an interactive tyre-size decoder, tyre ranges on a fitting-bay rack, an alloy wheel wall, alignment and balancing prices on a workshop job docket, fleet account tiers, live open-now hours and a Jamstacks contact component for quote and fleet enquiries.
